text: yet let me talk with thee: Or, let me reason the case with thee
they grow: Heb. they go on
they have called a multitude after thee: Or, they cried after thee fully | fair words: Heb. good things
the dearly beloved: Heb. the love
crieth out against me: Or, yelleth. Heb. giveth out his voice
speckled: Or, taloned | come to devour: Or, cause them to come
pleasant portion: Heb. portion of desire
